item.title: 共识：面向隐性信息多智能体推理的共形校准通信控制
item.summary: arXiv:2608.20564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems can improve reasoning by pooling diverse perspectives, but their effectiveness depends on coordinating communication, particularly in hidden-profile settings where each agent holds only part of the evidence required for a correct decision.
